mapper.select: SELECT common_doc_id, document_name, document_category, description, how_to_get, created_at FROM common_documents ORDER BY document_category, common_doc_id
SELECT common_doc_id, document_name, document_category, description, how_to_get, created_at FROM common_documents WHERE document_category = #{category} ORDER BY common_doc_id

SELECT rd.document_id, rd.service_id, rd.document_name, rd.document_description, rd.is_required, COALESCE(rd.how_to_get, cd.how_to_get) AS how_to_get, rd.document_order, rd.common_doc_id, rd.created_at, cd.document_category AS category FROM welfare_required_documents rd LEFT JOIN common_documents cd ON rd.common_doc_id = cd.common_doc_id WHERE rd.service_id = #{serviceId} ORDER BY rd.document_order, rd.document_id

SELECT uc.checklist_id, uc.member_id, uc.service_id, uc.document_id, uc.is_checked, uc.checked_at, uc.memo, uc.created_at, uc.updated_at, rd.document_name, rd.document_description, rd.is_required, COALESCE(rd.how_to_get, cd.how_to_get) AS how_to_get, rd.document_order FROM user_document_checklist uc JOIN welfare_required_documents rd ON uc.document_id = rd.document_id LEFT JOIN common_documents cd ON rd.common_doc_id = cd.common_doc_id WHERE uc.member_id = #{memberId} AND uc.service_id = #{serviceId} ORDER BY rd.document_order, rd.document_id

SELECT uc.checklist_id, uc.member_id, uc.service_id, uc.document_id, uc.is_checked, uc.checked_at, uc.memo, uc.created_at, uc.updated_at, rd.document_name, rd.document_description, rd.is_required, rd.how_to_get, rd.document_order FROM user_document_checklist uc JOIN welfare_required_documents rd ON uc.document_id = rd.document_id WHERE uc.member_id = #{memberId} AND uc.service_id = #{serviceId} AND uc.document_id = #{documentId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_document_checklist WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND service_id = #{serviceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_document_checklist (member_id, service_id, document_id, is_checked) SELECT #{memberId}, #{serviceId}, document_id, FALSE FROM welfare_required_documents WHERE service_id = #{serviceId}
mapper.select: SELECT internal_service_id FROM welfare_service_mapping WHERE api_service_id = #{apiServiceId} LIMIT 1
SELECT api_service_id FROM welfare_service_mapping WHERE internal_service_id = #{internalServiceId} LIMIT 1

SELECT internal_service_id FROM welfare_service_mapping WHERE service_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{serviceName}, '%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN service_name = #{serviceName} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, LENGTH(service_name) LIMIT 1

SELECT m.internal_service_id AS serviceId, m.api_service_id AS apiServiceId, m.service_name AS serviceName, m.api_source AS apiSource, COUNT(d.document_id) AS documentCount FROM welfare_service_mapping m JOIN welfare_required_documents d ON m.internal_service_id = d.service_id GROUP BY m.internal_service_id, m.api_service_id, m.service_name, m.api_source ORDER BY m.service_name
